# History | HowStuffWorks

> HowStuffWorks History provides accessible, well-researched articles on world history, historical figures, and pivotal events across civilizations and time periods.

The site covers major historical topics including North American and European history, civil rights movements, wars, disasters, and biographical profiles of influential historical figures. Content ranges from detailed investigations of historical events to myth-busting articles that separate fact from legend.

## Key Topics

- Historical Figures
- Historical Events
- World History
- American History
- European History
- Civil Rights History
- Biography
- Disasters and Tragedies
- Ottoman Empire
- Industrial Revolution
- World War II
- Lynching and Racial Violence
- Maritime History
- Educational Content
- History vs. Myth

## History Hubs & Collections

- [History | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com): Main history hub covering world regions, historical figures, and events.
- [Historical Figures | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-figures): Hub page featuring biographies of influential historical figures.
- [Historical Events | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-events): Hub page covering major historical events and turning points.
- [History vs. Myth | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/history-vs-myth): Curated collection separating historical fact from myth and legend.

## Regional History

- [North American History | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/north-american-history): Hub covering North American history, landmarks, and regional events.
- [European History | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/european-history): Hub covering European history, countries, and historical events.

## Civil Rights & Social History

- [Why Emmett Till's Murder Shook the Conscience of the U.S. | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-figures/emmett-till.htm): Detailed article on Emmett Till's lynching and civil rights impact.
- [Remembering Singer, Actor and Activist Harry Belafonte | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-figures/harry-belafonte.htm): Biography of Harry Belafonte, civil rights activist and entertainer.

## Major Wars & Global Conflicts

- [10 Biggest Wars in History With Death Tolls in the Tens of Millions | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/world-history/biggest-wars-in-history.htm): Comprehensive guide to history's deadliest wars and conflicts.
- [Why Did the Ottoman Empire Fall During the Industrial Revolution? | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/world-history/why-did-the-ottoman-empire-fall.htm): Analysis of Ottoman Empire's decline during Industrial Revolution.

## Historical Leadership & Power

- [10 of the Worst People in History: A Leadership Hall of Infamy | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-figures/worst-people-in-history.htm): Article on historical figures whose leadership caused mass atrocities.
- [5 Most Corrupt Presidents in U.S. History (Including a Civil War Hero) | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-figures/most-corrupt-presidents.htm): Analysis of most corrupt U.S. presidents and their scandals.
- [The Most Powerful People in the World Aren't Always the Richest | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-figures/most-powerful-people-in-the-world.htm): Analysis of global power, influence, and world leaders.
- [Top 5 Marie Antoinette Scandals | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-figures/top-5-marie-antoinette-scandals.htm): Article exploring Marie Antoinette's scandals during French Revolution.

## Disasters, Tragedies & Maritime History

- [The Bhopal Gas Tragedy Killed Thousands and Doomed Generations | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-events/bhopal-gas-tragedy.htm): Account of world's worst industrial disaster and its consequences.
- [The SS Edmund Fitzgerald and a Fateful Night on Lake Superior | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-events/edmund-fitzgerald.htm): Maritime history article on SS Edmund Fitzgerald shipwreck.
- [OceanGate: What Went Wrong and Why | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-events/oceangate.htm): Article on OceanGate Titan submersible disaster and engineering failure.
- [What Happened to MH370, the Missing Malaysia Airlines Flight? | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/historical-events/what-happened-to-mh370.htm): Investigation into Malaysia Airlines Flight 370's disappearance.

## Optional

- [Smallest Countries in the World | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/european-history/smallest-country-in-world.htm): Comparative geography article on world's smallest countries.
- [Norland College: Where the Royals Find Their Nannies | HowStuffWorks](https://history.howstuffworks.com/european-history/norland-college-royal-nannies.htm): Article on Norland College and British royal nanny training traditions.
